notes.title: Update: Version 1.11
notes.content:
[b]Hello there[/b] once again, Pizza Express fans! It's time for a new update, just in time for the holiday season! Here is the [b]changelog[/b]:
[list]
[*][b]FIXED[/b] a bug which caused the game to freeze when playing Challenge mode with one lone pizza on the menu.
[*][b]FIXED[/b] a bug which caused the game to crash when trying to editing a full menu in Challenge mode after having played an Endurance game.
[*][b]FIXED[/b] occasional dialogue errors which caused the characters to mix-up the player's gender.
[*][b]FIXED[/b] a problem with the achievement [i]Tough Like a Diamond[/i] which would fail to unlock if the objective [i]Feynman Point: Part II[/i] had already been completed.
[*][b]FIXED[/b] faulty objects being created when viewing the results for a game in Endurance mode after pressing the Enter key to go to the next page.
[*][b]ADDED[/b] a sound effect which triggers when the player drops an ingredient on an invalid place (such as outside a pizza).
[*][b]ADDED[/b] a sound effect in Arcade mode which triggers once every second when the player has 10 or less seconds left on the clock.
[*][b]LOWERED[/b] the time needed for the achievement [i]Wasting Your Time[/i] from 60 to 45 in-game minutes.
[*][b]UPDATED[/b] the clock in Arcade mode to shift color from white to red when running out of time.
[*][b]UPDATED[/b] the way some lines are drawn on the screen, in an effort to avoid gaps and/or [url=http://onniinteractive.altervista.org/BadPixels.gif]overflowing[/url]. If you noticed some imperfections before, please let me know if this new patch has solved this problem!
[*][b]UPDATED[/b] localization files.
[/list]
That was a somewhat lengthy list! I hope these small changes will let you enjoy the game even more. As always, suggestions and reports are very welcome on the [b][url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/375250/discussions/1/]game forums[/url][/b]. And last but not least, a sincere [b]thank you[/b] to [b]Silver Owl[/b] for pointing out a whole lot of small and big issues.

[b]Happy gaming![/b]

notes.title: Update: Version 1.10.01
notes.content:
[b]Good day[/b] once more, Pizza Express players!

[b]Two updates[/b] in less than one week? Hopefully the world is not coming to an end!
(Terrible) Jokes aside, this patch fixes a few bugs. Here is the [b]changelog[/b]:
[list]
[*][b]FIXED[/b] a bug which caused the game to crash whilst editing the restaurant menu in Challenge Mode.
[*][b]FIXED[/b] players being able to create a new pizza when a scarce number of ingredients in use would make impossible to do so (meaning that, for instance, should a player only use 2 toppings and one crust in their kitchen, they will be able to create and offer only 4 pizzas in total, even if their menu would allow for more).
[*][b]FIXED[/b] a graphical glitch which added a "0" in front of some results on the Endurance leaderboard.
[*][b]FIXED[/b] arrow misalignment whilst choosing whether to start a new game or load a savefile.
[/list]
By now, you know the drill - [b]have fun[/b] and please report any suspicious [b]bug activity[/b] on the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/375250/discussions/1/][b]game forums[/b][/url]! Thank you!

notes.title: Pizza Express is 80% off this week!
notes.content:
[b]Good day[/b], Pizza Express fans! It's time for some exciting news! But first...

[h1]Ode to virtual pizza[/h1]
[b]Summer[/b] is coming to an end,
and September starts next weekend.
[b]Back to work[/b] one must go,
and how [b]boring[/b] is that, oh no!
But [b]fear not[/b],
you're on the spot.
[b]Pizza Express is 80% off.[/b]

So [b]grab a copy[/b] and have some fun,
the offer is [b]valid for everyone.[/b]
Kill some time and make a pie,
to bring your restaurant [b]up high[/b].
Customize, advertize and get creative,
so customers will be appreciative.
And your hard work will [b]payoff.[/b]

But wait, I already own the game!
What could possibly be my aim?
Well, you have a friend, don't you?
Then [b]give them something to do[/b]!
[b]Next Monday is the end of this discount,[/b]
so you'd better keep that into account.
[b]Bye[/b] for now, [b]I'm signing off![/b]

[h1]Seriously now...[/h1]
[b]Pizza Express is 80% off until next Monday[/b] (September 5)[b]![/b] For [b]only $1.39/€1.39/£0.99[/b] (less than a slice of pizza!), you too can start building your own little pizza empire. Will you have what it takes to be the best restaurant in town? There's only one way to find it out!

[b]Have fun![/b]

notes.title: Update: Version 1.09
notes.content:
[b]Merry Christmas[/b], everybody!

This is the update you were probably waiting for: [b]improved tutorials[/b]! Yes, you can now say goodbye to Gastone's endless lectures about pizza making and [b]skip straight to the most important points[/b] of any tutorial by pressing the spacebar!

I have also [b]added support[/b] for [b]AZERTY[/b] and [b]Dvorak[/b] keyboards. Selecting a different keyboard layout will modify the [b]set of keys[/b] used to navigate menus and orders ([b]WASD[/b] on QWERTY/QWERTZ keyboards, [b]QZSD[/b] on AZERTY and [b],AOE[/b] on Dvorak).

Here's the complete changelog:
[list]
[*][b]ADDED[/b] support for AZERTY and Dvorak keyboards. The [b]keyboard layout[/b] can be set in the options.
[*][b]ADDED[/b] an option to always skip tutorials.
It is now [b]possible to navigate[/b] the profile creation menu using the WASD keys (or equivalent set).
[*][b]Pressing the spacebar[/b] during any tutorial will skip the tutorial to its next most important part.
[*][b]Lucky's messages[/b] during the Atmosphere tutorial now have a longer cooldown time when an important piece of information is presented.
[*][b]FIXED[/b] a bug which caused the game to crash during the first tutorial.
[*][b]FIXED[/b] a glitch which allowed the player to use the bottom topping stations during the first tutorial.
[*][b]FIXED[/b] a bug which, in rare instances, caused the game to crash at the end of days 16 and 25.
[*][b]UPDATED[/b] the game manual.
[*][b]UPDATED[/b] localization files.
[*]No snow added. Weather has been unusually mild. Boohoo.
[/list]

As always, if you happen to find a bug, make sure to [b]report[/b] it on the [b][url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/375250/discussions/1/]game forums[/url][/b] and I'll do my best to fix it ASAP!

That's all for now. Again, I wish you all a [b]very merry Christmas[/b] and a [b]wonderful 2016[/b]!

notes.title: Major update: Version 1.06
notes.content:
[b]Hello[/b] once again, Pizza Express players!

After a few months of development, [b]online leaderboards[/b] are finally here, along with 40 new achievements, new features and lots of improvements! To celebrate, Pizza Express will be [b]50% off this week[/b], so get it while it's hot! Meanwhile, here is the [b]changelog[/b]:
[list]
[*][b]ADDED[/b] Challenge Mode. This is an online mode where players can compete for the best score in two different game modes: Arcade and Endurance!
[*][b]ADDED[/b] 40 new achievements related to Challenge Mode.
[*][b]ADDED[/b] the option to remove pizzas from the menu.
[*][b]ADDED[/b] the option to remove ingredients from the kitchen. Doing so will consequently affect the menu, so be careful!
[*][b]ADDED[/b] further descriptions in the Edit menu screen when editing the pizzas.
[*][b]ADDED[/b] a sound to further notify the player when pizzas share the same name or recipe in the Edit menu screen.
[*][b]ADDED[/b] a new sound to notify the arrival of a new order when the restaurant is already full.
[*][b]ADDED[/b] a sound effect when clicking on cells in the Edit kitchen screen.
[*][b]ADDED[/b] new tips.
[*][b]FIXED[/b] sliders not saving the correct volume when switching between fullscreen and windowed mode.
[*][b]FIXED[/b] wrong pizzas being rarely considered correct.
[*][b]FIXED[/b] a rare bug that occurred when the player would try to toss away a pizza immediately after clicking on it to serve it.
[*][b]FIXED[/b] the splash screen failing to skip in certain instances.
[*][b]FIXED[/b] music not looping in the Evaluation screen.
[*][b]UPDATED[/b] the appearance of coins in the Evaluation screen.
[*][b]UPDATED[/b] the tutorials to reflect the most recent changes.
[*][b]UPDATED[/b] the file steam_api.dll to allow online play.
[*][b]UPDATED[/b] the game manual.
[*][b]UPDATED[/b] localisation files.
[/list]
As you can see, you entrepreneurs now have the chance to [b]remove ingredients[/b] from the kitchen and [b]delete pizzas[/b] from the menu, giving you even more freedom about your restaurant's organization! Remember, however, that the F.L.A.B. likes variety...

But talking about the main event, [b]online leaderboards[/b]! With the introduction of [b]Challenge Mode[/b], players now have the chance to battle for the number one spot in two different game modes: [b]Arcade[/b] and [b]Endurance[/b]. So spice up your kitchen, design your menu and go for it! The more difficult you make your game, the better your score will be (provided you can handle the heat!).

[h1][b]Arcade mode[/b][/h1]
In Arcade mode, players have [b]5 minutes[/b] to score as many points as possible, by serving pizzas and completing orders as usual. Don't make mistakes to increase your [b]combo counters[/b] faster, restock only when necessary to [b]avoid penalties[/b] and don't let your customers wait around too long. Sounds easy? Maybe, but there are a few [b]surprises[/b] waiting for you...

[h1][b]Endurance mode[/b][/h1]
Endurance mode is pretty self-explainatory: run your restaurant for [b]as long as you can[/b] doing the usual stuff! Boring? Not when you're under [b]constant pressure[/b]! Making customers wait and committing mistakes will drain your [b][i]Reputation Points[/i][/b] away, and when they hit zero, it's game over! But fear not, you'll have a [b]secret weapon[/b] you can use to survive...

[h1][b]Excitement![/b][/h1]
So what are you waiting for? [b]Glory[/b] is waiting for you! Do you have what it takes to be the best pizza chef in the world? There's only a way to find that out...!

As always, feel free to [b]report any bug[/b] on the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/375250/discussions/1/][b]game forums[/b][/url]. I'll try to address them as quickly as possible! Thank you for your time, and [b]happy gaming[/b]!

[h1]Extra info[/h1]
Further info about this update are available [url=http://onniinteractive.altervista.org/PizzaExpress/up_19_10_2015.html][b]here[/b][/url].

notes.title: Major update: Version 1.06
notes.content:
[b]Hello[/b] once again, Pizza Express players!

After a few months of development, [b]online leaderboards[/b] are finally here, along with 40 new achievements, new features and lots of improvements! To celebrate, Pizza Express will be [b]50% off this week[/b], so get it while it's hot! Meanwhile, here is the [b]changelog[/b]:
[list]
[*][b]ADDED[/b] Challenge Mode. This is an online mode where players can compete for the best score in two different game modes: Arcade and Endurance!
[*][b]ADDED[/b] 40 new achievements related to Challenge Mode.
[*][b]ADDED[/b] the option to remove pizzas from the menu.
[*][b]ADDED[/b] the option to remove ingredients from the kitchen. Doing so will consequently affect the menu, so be careful!
[*][b]ADDED[/b] further descriptions in the Edit menu screen when editing the pizzas.
[*][b]ADDED[/b] a sound to further notify the player when pizzas share the same name or recipe in the Edit menu screen.
[*][b]ADDED[/b] a new sound to notify the arrival of a new order when the restaurant is already full.
[*][b]ADDED[/b] a sound effect when clicking on cells in the Edit kitchen screen.
[*][b]ADDED[/b] new tips.
[*][b]FIXED[/b] sliders not saving the correct volume when switching between fullscreen and windowed mode.
[*][b]FIXED[/b] wrong pizzas being rarely considered correct.
[*][b]FIXED[/b] a rare bug that occurred when the player would try to toss away a pizza immediately after clicking on it to serve it.
[*][b]FIXED[/b] the splash screen failing to skip in certain instances.
[*][b]FIXED[/b] music not looping in the Evaluation screen.
[*][b]UPDATED[/b] the appearance of coins in the Evaluation screen.
[*][b]UPDATED[/b] the tutorials to reflect the most recent changes.
[*][b]UPDATED[/b] the file steam_api.dll to allow online play.
[*][b]UPDATED[/b] the game manual.
[*][b]UPDATED[/b] localisation files.
[/list]
As you can see, you entrepreneurs now have the chance to [b]remove ingredients[/b] from the kitchen and [b]delete pizzas[/b] from the menu, giving you even more freedom about your restaurant's organization! Remember, however, that the F.L.A.B. likes variety...

But talking about the main event, [b]online leaderboards[/b]! With the introduction of [b]Challenge Mode[/b], players now have the chance to battle for the number one spot in two different game modes: [b]Arcade[/b] and [b]Endurance[/b]. So spice up your kitchen, design your menu and go for it! The more difficult you make your game, the better your score will be (provided you can handle the heat!).

[h1][b]Arcade mode[/b][/h1]
In Arcade mode, players have [b]5 minutes[/b] to score as many points as possible, by serving pizzas and completing orders as usual. Don't make mistakes to increase your [b]combo counters[/b] faster, restock only when necessary to [b]avoid penalties[/b] and don't let your customers wait around too long. Sounds easy? Maybe, but there are a few [b]surprises[/b] waiting for you...

[h1][b]Endurance mode[/b][/h1]
Endurance mode is pretty self-explainatory: run your restaurant for [b]as long as you can[/b] doing the usual stuff! Boring? Not when you're under [b]constant pressure[/b]! Making customers wait and committing mistakes will drain your [b][i]Reputation Points[/i][/b] away, and when they hit zero, it's game over! But fear not, you'll have a [b]secret weapon[/b] you can use to survive...

[h1][b]Excitement![/b][/h1]
So what are you waiting for? [b]Glory[/b] is waiting for you! Do you have what it takes to be the best pizza chef in the world? There's only a way to find that out...!

As always, feel free to [b]report any bug[/b] on the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/375250/discussions/1/][b]game forums[/b][/url]. I'll try to address them as quickly as possible! Thank you for your time, and [b]happy gaming[/b]!

[h1]Extra info[/h1]
Further info about this update are available [url=http://onniinteractive.altervista.org/PizzaExpress/up_19_10_2015.html][b]here[/b][/url].
La lista dei cambiamenti è disponibile anche in italiano [url=http://onniinteractive.altervista.org/PizzaExpress/up_19_10_2015_it.html][b]qui[/b][/url].

notes.content:
Greetings once more, Pizza Express fans!

This new updates the game to version 1.05. A number of minor bugs have been fixed, and a new, very small feature has been introduced. Here is the changelog:

[*][b]UPDATED[/b] localisation files.
[/list]
As always, feel free to [b]report[/b] a bug on the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/375250/discussions/1/][b]game forums[/b][/url] if you find any.

[b]Happy gaming[/b], and [b]thank you[/b] for your support!

[list]

Enjoy!

notes.title: Update: Version 1.03
notes.content:
Hello there, Pizza Express fans!

This update is a big(gish) one, with new features, bug fixes and so on! Here's the changelog:

[list]
[*] [b]ADDED[/b] the option to [b]speed up time[/b] when there are no customers to serve. Time speed up can be enabled by [b]pressing the keys 1 to 4 on the numeric keypad[/b] (numpad).
Press 1 to restore time to its normal speed. Press the other keys (2 to 4) to speed up time by x2, x3 or x6.
[*] [b]ADDED[/b] a small animation for the clock icon. The clock turns faster the faster the in-game speed.
[*] [b]ADDED[/b] [b]mouse acceleration[/b]. It is possible to enable it from the in-game options. Players can choose among five different preset or define their own custom settings. For further info, please [b]check out the game manual at pages 15-18[/b].
[*] [b]ADDED[/b] a third page to the options submenu to accomodate the new features. From here, it is possible to edit the default time speed up value and enable/disable/customize the mouse acceleration.
[*] [b]FIXED[/b] the player being able to quit the catalogue when in tutorial, rendering it impossible to complete thus forcing the user to kill the game to quit it.
[*] [b]FIXED[/b] the game playing the wrong F.L.A.B.'s gala cutscene following a particular storyline.
[*] [b]FIXED[/b] the game being unable to continue to the management menu after meeting Brush for the first time.
[*] [b]UPDATED[/b] [b]Lucky's and Gastone's suggestions[/b] about pizzas pricing. Both characters will now give detailed info about a pizza the lower the game difficulty is. Playing at higher difficulties will make their suggestions vaguer.
[*] [b]UPDATED[/b] some [b]achievements to make them easier[/b] to unlock. [b]Special customers[/b] (as well as suggestions) [b]now appear even after the completion of the main adventure[/b], giving players the opportunity to satisfy their cravings and unlock the related achievement. Some of these customers are now a little less demanding regarding their pizza.
The achievement [i][b]10 pizzas in 10 seconds[/b][/i] now requires the player to serve ANY 10 pizzas in 10 seconds, instead of 10 different recipes in 10 seconds.
[*] [b]UPDATED[/b] the game manual.
[*] [b]UPDATED[/b] localisation files.
[/list]

Of course, [b]keep an eye out for possible bugs[/b]! I tried my best to deliver a bug-free update, but as always, something might have found its way into the game... If you happen to find one, make sure to report it on the [b][url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/375250/discussions/1/]game forums[/url][/b]!

That's all for now. Have a great day and [b]happy gaming[/b]!

Simone

notes.title: Minor updates: Version 1.01.01 - 1.01.03
notes.content:
Hello there, Pizza Express players!

The most [b]attentive[/b] players might have noticed that in the last 24 hours, [b]three small updates have been released[/b]. They solve a number of silly bugs which caused the game to crash in some instances.

Here is the [b]list[/b] of bugs fixed:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug which caused the game to crash on day 9 when playing on a female profile due to a typo in variable declaration.
[*] Fixed dialogues not loading properly on day 13.
[*] Fixed a few game over scenes where a typo in variable declaration caused the game to crash.
[*] Fixed a bug which allowed the player to have a piggy bank and extra customers' patience when playing Gastone's tutorial and the test to evaluate the player's skill.
[*] Fixed glitchy lines of text because of missing separation in language files.
[*] Steam Cloud now works as intended. I had forgotten to enable it for public customers. Whoops!
[/list]

If you happen to [b]find a bug[/b], you can [b]report it [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/375250/discussions/1/]here[/url][/b] on Pizza Express forums.

Thank you for your time, and [b]happy gaming[/b]!

Simone
